reviewer: Assistant source inspection, not independent human adjudication or vulnerability reproduction
scope: Tandoor CVE-2022-23071 attempted-fix review; downloaded dependency sources were inspected as inert data

validators.archive_check: Downloaded archive SHA256 matched the release metadata; members were read in memory without filesystem extraction or execution

url_module.inspection: The bracketed IPv6 alternative is outside named private_ip/private_host groups. Its compressed branch accepts ::1; public=True checks neither IPv6 address class nor resolved hostname addresses. Literal localhost and selected private IPv4 values are restricted, which is narrower than internal-destination confinement. No regex or downloaded validator was executed.

requests.inspection: Reviewed Tandoor GET calls supply no allow_redirects=False or per-hop URL validation. Redirect following is additional evidence against interpreting the initial lexical URL check as a general SSRF boundary.

limits: These retained excerpts and full-content digests are review evidence, not complete archived dependency modules; re-fetch the exact release to repeat full-source inspection.
No outbound request to a loopback/private endpoint, DNS resolution probe, imported dependency execution, or application test was performed.
The finding concerns whether the selected after-code establishes an effective fixing counterpart; it does not invalidate the CVE or establish every endpoint's exploitability.
